skills.name: b7s-ask
skills.description: Re-ask the questions Claude just posed in plain text via the structured AskUserQuestion UI — synthesizes 2-4 options per question from the conversation context. Spanish-default, English when the conversation is in English.

skills.name: b7s-brainstorm
skills.description: Freestyle brainstorm capture (Mexican Spanish) — listen, organize faithfully, save to .brainstorms/inbox/, deepen via AskUserQuestion.

skills.name: b7s-create-skill
skills.description: Scaffold and iterate new skills inside the local behagoras-skills clone using the skill-creator methodology — runs the full interview/draft/eval loop, updates skills.json + commands + README + package.json, validates the manifest, runs pnpm lint, commits atomically, and opens a PR with the chosen release label.

skills.name: b7s-prioritize
skills.description: Rank executable prompts by urgency, dependencies, and TODO coverage — closes the b7s trio (brainstorm → review → prioritize). Read-only.

skills.name: b7s-review
skills.description: Review brainstorm TODOs and move files between statuses (inbox/in-progress/completed/archived). Pairs with b7s-brainstorm.

skills.name: video-transcript
skills.description: Extract transcripts from any video URL (YouTube, Reels, TikTok, Vimeo, ...).
